assignments.reason: דלות (destitution) is essentially the same concept as דלות ועניות already in Package 2 via additions. The Torah explicitly identifies poverty as the state of הסתרת פנים: 'הדלות בא על ידי פגם התפלין, על ידי פגם של אמת' — poverty IS the condition of damaged truth/face-concealment. Its essential nature is the material manifestation of the evil state of judgment and concealment, not merely a consequence of it.

האוחז במדת אמת (the one who holds to the attribute of truth) IS a person in the state of אמת. The node's essential nature is truth itself — it describes being embedded in the truth-quality that is Package 1's core. The Torah says 'קושטא קאי' — truth stands — and this node is the human embodiment of that standing-in-truth.

ממון (wealth/money) is the same concept as עשירות already in Package 1 via additions. The Torah treats material prosperity as an aspect of the truth-state: 'קושטא קאי — זה ממונו שמעמידו על רגליו.' Wealth IS the manifestation of truth's standing-power in the material world. Its essential nature is the positive material expression of the truth-domain.

נצולין מדלות ועניות (being saved from poverty) is the positive state of material well-being that flows from אמת/תפלין/יעקב. Its essential nature is the same domain as עשירות (already in Package 1): the material abundance that characterizes the truth-state. The Torah says 'עיקר השפע והעשירות נמשך על ידי בחינת יעקב שהוא בחינת אמת בחינת תפלין' — salvation from poverty IS the shefa of the truth-domain.

The essential nature of this node is divine face-illumination — the central quality of the truth package.

new_packages.label: שְׁבִירַת תַּאֲוַת אֲכִילָה וְתַעֲנִית
new_packages.label_en: Breaking the Desire for Food and Fasting
new_packages.reason: These five nodes all share the essential nature of ascetic spiritual practice — the deliberate restraint of bodily appetite. This is the Torah's central practical action (eitza), the pivot that moves a person from the evil state (Package 2: הסתרת פנים/דינים) to the good state (Package 1: אמת/נשיאות פנים). They are not aspects of truth itself (Package 1) nor aspects of concealment (Package 2); they are the PRACTICE of self-discipline that bridges the two. The Torah opens with this concept ('מי שהוא משבר תאות אכילה') and the entire causal chain flows from it. תענית (fasting) is the ritual institution of the same practice: 'גוזרין תענית לשבר תאות אכילה.' כשתשדד את הבהמיות (subduing animality) is the same action expressed through the agricultural metaphor of 'בשדך לבהמתך.' All five nodes share one essential nature: holy restraint of appetite.

new_packages.label: מוֹפְתִים וּבְרִיאָה חֲדָשָׁה
new_packages.reason: These five nodes share the essential nature of supernatural divine outcomes — miracles, wonders, and the creation of new heavens and earth. They are not aspects of truth (Package 1) or concealment (Package 2) or ascetic practice (new_1); they are the culmination of the Torah's causal chain — the cosmic consequences that flow from the entire positive axis. The Torah says 'על ידי שבור תאות אכילה נעשה מופתים ופלאות' — through breaking food-desire, miracles are performed. The node 'כשאנו אוכלים שפע אמת הבא דרך ארץ ישראל ואחר כך אנו מדברים הלולו של הקב"ה' describes the composite action of eating truth's abundance and praising God — whose essential nature is sacred partnership with God in creation ('שותף להקב"ה'), belonging to the same miraculous/creative domain. All five nodes are expressions of supernatural transformation of the natural order.
